# IT City Lucknow — farmer-allotted plots and land-pooling land

> Independent resale service for (A) developed plots that the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) has allotted to land-pooling farmers in IT City, Sultanpur Road, Lucknow, and (B) farm land in the IT City scheme villages that goes into land pooling. Not the official LDA website. Updated 24 November 2026.

## Key facts
- IT City: LDA township of about 1,054 ha (about 2,604 acres) on Sultanpur Road near Kisan Path, Mohanlalganj tehsil, Lucknow
- 11 villages: Bakkas, Sikandarpur Amoliya, Siddhpura, Parehta, Rakibabad, Mohari Khurd, Mohari Kalan, Khujauli, Bhatwara, Sonai Kanjehra, Pahadnagar Tikariya
- Farmer allotments: three 2026 lotteries, 2,197 plots to 1,465 land-pooling farmers in sectors 9, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 30
- Land returned in pooling: about 25% of the pooled area as developed plots so far; LDA board (2 Nov 2026) approved 50% back for owners pooling 10 acres or more, and the land-pooling SOP
- Selling notified land (since 28 Oct 2026): allowed if the buyer files an affidavit that the land will join the scheme through land pooling, and the sale deed records it
- Transfer of a farmer's allotted plot in the notified phase-1 area needs the District Collector's prior written permission; permission status is given for each plot with its price
- Land not pooled is to be acquired at four times the circle rate in rural areas (about 300 ha, Oct 2026)
- Public launch: planned for 23 Nov 2026 with farmers' allotment letters; it did not take place; December expected, no official date; public registration not open (Amar Ujala, 23 Nov 2026)
- Roads: LDA will use soil brought from outside instead of local black clay (Amar Ujala, 23 Nov 2026)

## Farmer-allotted plot sizes available
- 35 m² (377 sq ft)
- 72 m² (775 sq ft)
- 128 m² (1,378 sq ft)
- 162 m² (1,744 sq ft)
- 200 m² (2,153 sq ft)
- 288 m² (3,100 sq ft)
Prices, sector and permission status are shared on WhatsApp for each plot.
